snippet.title: Pinly - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Pinly is a Plinko roguelike that blends castle defense with loot management. Build your ultimate loadout from a growing arsenal of weapons and armor, then slot your weapons into the Plinko board and watch strategy and chaos collide. Each day the hordes grow deadlier and the loot grows stronger. Upgrade your weapons, refine your armor, and find the build that holds the line. How long can you survive?

Demo Available Now
https://anigram.itch.io/pinly
